domains.name: Dependency Schedule Computation
domains.scope: Diagnose prerequisite graph cycles, select ready work and compute dependency-only duration baselines with explicit models.

skills.name: dependency-critical-path-slack
skills.description: Compute earliest and latest task times and total slack from supplied durations when a dependency-only completion baseline is needed.

skills.name: prerequisite-cycle-witness
skills.description: Produce an explicit closed dependency path when a prerequisite graph cannot support a completion order.

skills.name: ready-task-priority-frontier
skills.description: Compute a deterministic next-task shortlist from completion evidence and explicit priority when blocked or already-running work must not consume available dispatch slots.
